messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate detected in cyanus-prod (Cyanus VPC, dedicated pool cp-42). 5xx rate >50% for last 2m, P95 latency 2.3s. Pager: @Jamie_oncall.
Jamie: on it — joining bridge now. can someone drop the most recent deploy diff?
Elaine: joining bridge. initial check: noisy tenant suspected (spike sustained across 3 nodes in cp-42). metrics + logs look like KV-cache thrashing after heavy long-context requests.
Sasha: seeing a config change pushed 18:05 UTC that adjusted autoscale cooldown to 90s. rolling back to 30s now (kubectl apply -f /ops/autoscale/cp-42.yaml — reverting cooldown).
Jamie: thanks. rolling mitigation plan: 1) isolate cyanus-prod to spare nodes, 2) enable model fallback to quantized-8 variant for that tenant, 3) prefix caching tweak. doing 1 now.
Michael: paging from CS — Cyanus is a 2-tier enterprise customer, lots of traffic from their production apps. they already contacted support; asking for an exec note ASAP.
Carly: on calls with their AMs. need ETA and customer impact summary for exec. also we should start thinking about credits.
Elaine: isolation step complete: shifted cyanus-prod to isolation-nodes-5/6. Traffic now routed via isolation pool. Error rate dropped to ~12% but latency still ~1.1s.
Jamie: enabling model fallback for cyanus-prod to redwood/llama-4-quant8 (compatible variant). expect lower latency and fewer OOMs. toggling route in router-service: POST /routes/override {tenant: cyanus-prod, model: llama4-q8} (applied).
Sasha: cache tuning applied: increased KV cache size and lowered eviction threshold for cp-42. watching.
Jamie: updates: errors down to 3.2%, P95 650ms. mitigation nominally effective. we'll keep isolation for now while we validate.
Michael: initial customer impact estimate for exec: 20 min of total downtime across 3 regions, ~14% of requests returned degraded quality due to fallback for ~40 min, no data exfiltration. customer reported some 5xxs from 18:04–18:22 UTC.
Paul: can you capture token counts, failed requests, and avg latency per region? exec will want concise bullet list + timeline.
Michael: sending quick numbers: total requests 1.2M in window, failed 42k (3.5%), degraded-model requests ~165k (13.8%), top affected region: eu-west-1. attaching raw counts in casework.
Carly: thanks. recommend we propose credits = max(7 days of hosted equivalent or 2% of last monthly invoice), whichever is higher, pending legal. we can refine after RCA.
Elaine: root cause prelim: autoscale cooldown change + heavy long-context workload from Cyanus causing KV thrash -> memory pressure -> OOM/retries. Mitigations: rollback autoscale, isolate tenant, enable fallback, KV cache tuning.
Jamie: planning RCA and comms. Owners: Elaine (technical RCA), Sasha (config change timeline + infra), Michael & Carly (customer comm + exec brief), Paul (exec review). Target: internal RCA draft by tomorrow 14:00 UTC, exec brief + proposed credits by EOD today.
Sasha: note: the config change came from infra-ops automation job #a-2026-431 that rolled across multiple pools. Adding a step to require canary for dedicated pools.
Michael: draft exec lines: "On DATE at 18:04 UTC, a config change to autoscale cooldown contributed to customer-facing errors for Cyanus. We isolated the tenant, enabled a fallback model, and applied cache tuning; service restored to SLO within ~18 minutes. We're proposing a credit and operational safeguards. Full RCA to follow."
Jamie: tagging followups: @Elaine please include exact timeline of error rates and the node IDs for isolation. @Sasha add the automation job diff and who approved. @Carly & @Michael coordinate the wording with legal and AMs; keep exec note tight.
Elaine: will attach prometheus graphs + klog excerpts to RCA. planning to include the command diff and a short reproduction script.
Carly: I'll draft the customer-facing note and a short executive one-pager. proposing initial credit offer: 1 week free on dedicated pool usage + SLA credit equal to 2% of last invoice. will confirm once legal chimes in.
Paul: good plan. also recommend a follow-up: scheduled postmortem meeting with Cyanus execs next Wed to walk the timeline and mitigations.
Jamie: closing loop on bridge: mitigation holds, incident moved to post-incident. Creating ticket INC-2026-431-cyanus for RCA & comms. if any regressions ping me directly. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident updated — status: mitigated -> post-incident review. assignees: Elaine, Sasha, Michael, Carly. SLA impact flag: enterprise-customer.
Jamie: thanks team — appreciate the quick response. will own the RCA review.
